cc:Work.dc:description: Constant anisotropic Kelvin tensor and sine displacement, identical material/force/zero exterior displacement for primal MHM n8 P3/r1/P1 and native conforming P3 n64. Cauchy stress is the physical constitutive gradient, not an H(div) recovery. All panels show actual MHM macro boundaries; one-sided values are not averaged. CC BY 4.0; IPES Research Group; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
